career_goals_and_ambitions: Breana aims to open her own art studio and gallery in Virginia Beach, creating a space that fosters creativity and community. She wants to exhibit her work internationally, challenging herself to push the boundaries of her art. However, her emotional stability and preference for solitude make her wary of the intense pressure and publicity that can come with fame. Instead, she hopes to achieve recognition for her art while maintaining a balanced, harmonious life.
